mismatch.sourceBehavior: When no ordinary armor or accessories remain, C reports the armor embedded in the player's skin.

summary: The v95 C recording performs a legal controlled polymorph into a gray dragon while wearing only ordinary gray dragon scales; C converts those scales into global uskin and removes them from uarm. On the final ordinary T command, C prints the merged-skin message. The JavaScript replay prints the generic no-armor message instead. A fresh current-base session replay at 531610d03099f0757adda49f2861a53a1824c4ee still has exactly one unmatched screen: 54 of 55 match; RNG is 2857/2857 and cursors 55/55. In JS, the controlled merge stores the object at state.uskin, but do_wear.js:dotakeoff reads state.u.uskin. No JS source reference otherwise stores or reads a nested u.uskin value, so this guard tests a different state location than the writer and C global uskin branch.
